findings.severity: MEDIUM (blocks design acceptance; B6-M1 residual, shared plain behaviour)
findings.area: Per-kind continuation policy for CANCEL (IDEMPOTENT_SAFETY) and RECEIPT_OBSERVE
findings.statement: lifecycle.register/invoke gate every CONTINUATIONS kind through _parent_current. That predicate is the TERMINAL_FRAME continuation policy: no QUARANTINE/RETIRE fact, live claim rights (leaseExpiresAt > now, notAfter > now+5), leaseActive and workloadActive, and activation lease. RECEIPT_OBSERVE also refuses any non-DRAIN fact. In 72028, cancel and observe are exactly the recovery paths that run AFTER start authority is lost. node_channels.py:124-139 snapshot(observation_only=True) skips require_execution (containment) and the online/heartbeat freshness check. dispatch.py:166-184 selects operation='cancel' for a lost start authority ('Keep all leases until the authenticated physical receipt'; start_authority_lost -> cancel_and_await_receipt) and 'observe' otherwise, without assert_fences or resource-lease freshness. Root msg_8b52dd815cae: continuation is evaluated per kind against the ORIGINAL policy ('where original requires'), and existing containment facts apply independently. With Rev7 as proven, a contained Node or an expired-lease run can never obtain its Node tombstone/stop receipt ordinarily, so its claim waits for OP physical recovery. That is the same routine-operator-escalation class B6-M1 objected to, and it changes plain behaviour through shared procedures.

counterexamples.C1: EXECUTE parent registered+invoked; OP sets QUARANTINE; register(CANCEL, parent) -> None (expected allowed, as 72028 observation_only)
counterexamples.C2: EXECUTE parent; now += 301 (claim lease expired); register(CANCEL, parent) -> None (expected allowed: dispatch cancels after start-authority loss)
counterexamples.controls: C5 Node offline: CANCEL allowed; C6 parent UNCERTAIN: CANCEL allowed. So the defect is precisely the containment/lease predicates inherited from TERMINAL_FRAME.

requiredFix: Publish a closed per-kind continuation table in the catalog/schema and model. TERMINAL_FRAME = R12 as now (exact claimed terminal, live lease/deadline, DRAIN allowed, QUARANTINE/RETIRE refused).

CANCEL and RECEIPT_OBSERVE: exact original permit/command hash, claim and parent handle, current identity/epoch/generation/channel C/DER and authenticated observe scope. Allowed under DRAIN, QUARANTINE, offline/stale heartbeat, expired claim lease and expired activation lease, mirroring 72028 observation_only. Refused for a wrong parent/command/identity/epoch/generation/channel and an unauthenticated scope. Claims are retained until the original terminal receipt path.

Stateful fixtures: C1-C4 allowed and claims retained; a wrong-parent/epoch/channel cancel refused; a CANCEL TERMINAL_CLEAN via the original receipt path frees only its matched claim; the parent EXECUTE UNCERTAIN row still needs protected recovery (Root rule unchanged).
